message.content: {"caption":"Grouped bar chart comparing mean task reward for three skill conditions across eight domains and an overall average.","description":"The chart plots mean task reward (%) on a vertical axis from 0 to 100, marked at 20-point intervals. The horizontal categories are SE, OWC, NS, IPS, FE, MOR, CS, MCP, and Avg. Each category has three adjacent bars: gray for No skill, ochre for Curated skill, and blue for SelfEvoSkill. A dashed vertical line separates the eight domain categories from Avg. Approximate read-offs show that SelfEvoSkill is higher than Curated skill in SE, OWC, NS, IPS, MOR, CS, and MCP, and the two are about equal in FE. Across the domain bars, No skill is generally lower; at OWC it ties Curated skill, and at SE it is higher than Curated skill. The Avg. bars are about 41% for No skill, 57% for Curated skill, and 74% for SelfEvoSkill.","figure_type":"chart","chart_values":[{"series":"No
